method: Read-only exact source audit and independently copied/replayed author-built kernel library harnesses, not reviewer rebuild. Full crate/test manifest recomputed from exact Git blobs.

manifest.selector: Git path order; crates/ entries ending .rs or Cargo.toml, including crate tests
manifest.encoding: lowercase file SHA256 + two spaces + path + LF

review: Both kernels reconstruct full signature equations separately from target roots, storage initialization, actual parent loans and access rights. Analyze uses bounded union-find; Verify uses independently implemented representative substitution.

Incoming declared variables are rigid. Each call gets fresh formal variables which unify with actual retained classes; actual values are not independently freshened. One phantom constructor remains one consistent semantic class across direct/indirect calls; using distinct constructors is the nearest passing neighbor.

FunctionRef checks complete actual parameter/result types, ordinary Direct target and relation entailment. Required target equalities must follow from the pointer relation; labels are compared as an equivalence relation rather than treated as permissions.

Qualified boundary class selectors are separate from physical borrow positions. Actual slot loads connect to their verified local class; phantom-only constructors add no physical target roots. Ordinary ReadAddress/WriteAddress cannot copy or overwrite BorrowedStorage outside its protocol.

All-block instruction admission remains explicit. Raw wrong-target implication, wrong actual outer/class equation and reused phantom-class controls reject in independent Verify and decoded Wire; candidate identities are constructed for the actual modules.
Indirect actual address arguments have simultaneous ordinary loan checks. Matching semantic equations do not permit duplicated exclusive arguments; nearest distinct inputs pass.
The revised charge helper pays O(1) row/count reservations before row/path walks at repeated call, role and target uses; variable growth and equality propagation consume the same request budget.

budgets.controls: N-1 ResourceLimit and repeat/freshN stable verified identity; no default quota change
